qs.q: Which specific mode of transmission is uniquely reported for Ancylostoma duodenale and not for Necator americanus?
qs.e: Transmammary and transplacental transmission are only reported for A. duodenale. Both species share percutaneous penetration as their primary mode of infection.

qs.q: A public health assessment evaluates two distinct hookworm species and notes a unique transmission capability exclusive to Ancylostoma duodenale. What is this special route of transmission?
o: Direct skin penetration of bare feet
qs.e: Transmammary and transplacental transmission have only been reported for Ancylostoma duodenale. Other modes like skin penetration are shared by both major hookworm species.
